evidence.note: Response Destination points at the old/staging hostname, not the configured ACS URL.
Recipient matches, so the mismatch is isolated to the Response Destination.

output.fix: The IdP is sending the response to the wrong ACS URL, and the symptom suggests the SP's ACS URL is still registered under the old hostname on the IdP side. In the Google Workspace SAML app configuration, set the ACS URL to https://sp.example.com/saml/acs and make sure the SP entity ID is https://sp.example.com/saml/metadata. Update any cached or imported SP metadata, then have the SP send AuthnRequests with the new AssertionConsumerServiceURL. Keep strict Destination and Recipient checks on the SP side. The Destination should then equal the ACS URL exactly.

alternatives.why_not: The assertion is signed, which is what the SP requires. The Response itself is unsigned, but that is acceptable here.
